About

No pressure. Just honest guidance.

Ten years, three hundred families, one philosophy: treat every client like family and every home like it matters.

Ash Ahluwalia, Realtor, Toronto
The person behind the deals

Calm, clear, and in your corner.

Real estate is the biggest financial decision most families ever make. Ash's job is to make it feel smaller — breaking every step into plain language, flagging risks before they become problems, and never letting a deadline rush a decision.

Based in North York and working across the GTA, Ash specializes in condos and family homes from Scarborough to Etobicoke, with a particular depth in the North York and Agincourt corridors he calls home.

How Ash works

Three promises.

i.

Straight answers

If a home is overpriced, you'll hear it. If walking away is the right call, you'll hear that too.

ii.

Always reachable

Calls and texts returned the same day — including evenings and weekends, because that's when real estate happens.

iii.

After the keys

Contractors, lawyers, movers, tax questions — clients stay clients long after closing day.
